core_principle: HEAVY OBJECTS OBEY GRAVITY. WALL OBJECTS OBEY WALLS. FOREGROUND OBJECTS MAY OVERLAP BOTH. OBJECTS ALSO OBEY BELIEVABLE RELATIVE SCALE AND PHYSICAL RELATIONSHIPS.

edge_types.ON: A rests on B's top surface. Valid iff B.can_support includes A's class (or size class) and A's baseline lies in B's top band (existing 3M.3 surface rule: top −10px … +35% of B height).
edge_types.BESIDE: A and B share the floor plane with adjacent, non-crossing silhouettes; touching at an outer edge is allowed; crossing the interior is not.
edge_types.UNDER: Only for ground-plane objects (rug): A is under B when B's baseline lies inside A's patch and A is drawn behind B.
edge_types.HANGS_ABOVE: Wall object A above floor object B: A's baseline ≥ B's top − tolerance (may descend behind B's top edge by ≤ 25% of A's height); A is always behind B.
edge_types.IN_FRONT_OF: A closer than B: A.baseline > B.baseline by ≥ depth_step and A's z above B; overlap allowed only over B's lower edge region (bottom 35% of B's height) unless A is FOREGROUND-role and B is a wall object.
edge_types.FOREGROUND_ACCENT: Small object (foreground_suitability ≥ 2) overlapping the lower edge of any larger object; the overlap region must lie within the bottom 35% of the larger object's silhouette.

invalid_examples.why: same plane, similar baselines, silhouettes cross the chair's seat/arm interior — Individual Seller A
a painting with its baseline in the floor band and no 'leaning' declaration
heavy object without a floor baseline
vase rendered taller than the sofa without catalogue dimensions
table top wider than the chair seat without dimensions — Individual Seller A
floor lamp shorter than the chair without dimensions — Individual Seller A
table lamp needs a support surface
wall object drawn in front of a floor object
jewellery placed at room scale beside furniture

collision_detection.same_plane_pairs: For every pair of floor-plane objects: compute mask intersection at placed size. If intersection > 400px AND |baseline_a − baseline_b| < depth_step (default 6% of canvas height) AND the intersection touches the back object's interior band (20%–80% of its height) → THROUGH collision (hard fail).
collision_detection.lower_edge_layering: If the front object's baseline is lower (closer) by ≥ depth_step and the intersection lies within the bottom 35% of the back object's silhouette → valid layering.
collision_detection.protected_features: Any intersection covering a protected feature (seat, arms, wings, dial, face, signature) > 15% is a hard fail regardless of depth.
collision_detection.support_check: An object whose class has plane table/shelf/pedestal must have an ON edge to a supporter; else UNSUPPORTED (hard fail) unless declared 'floor-standing instance' with dimensions ≥ 24 in.
collision_detection.wall_check: Wall objects: no contact shadow; baseline above the floor band + tolerance; never in front of a floor object; unchanged from 3M.3 plus the HANGS_ABOVE tolerance.
collision_detection.ground_check: Rug: drawn behind all floor objects, patch never vertical, never over an object.

scale_model.reference: scene_scale_px_per_in = anchor_pixel_height / anchor_typical_height_in, computed from the primary anchor (anchor_weight 3, or the largest anchor_weight 2).
scale_model.placement_height_px: typical_height_in × scene_scale × depth_factor(plane, baseline) where depth_factor ranges 0.85 (rear) … 1.25 (foreground)
scale_model.tolerance: ±20% for same-plane objects; ±35% when the object is FOREGROUND-role and closer
scale_model.dimension_priority: lot.dimensions (catalogue) > class typical; when catalogue dimensions exist they are authoritative and the tolerance applies to them
scale_model.violation: an object outside tolerance relative to the anchor is a SCALE violation; 'vase taller than sofa' is never allowed without catalogue dimensions that prove it
scale_model.category_composition_exception: CATEGORY_GROUP / SINGLE_LOT families use category scale (objects of one class at uniform scale, coins slightly enlarged) — the room-scale model does not apply there
